name: Chroma Cache (FBCache skeleton, shape-only check)
plain: A Chroma-only cache adapted from FBCache code, where the similarity check has been reduced to a shape comparison and the threshold input commented out. In effect a pure percent window and interval decide reuse.
math: are_two_tensors_similar(t1,t2) := t1.shape==t2.shape. Validator from start, end, cache_interval decides. Reuse tail buffers when allowed.

props.hook: patch context (create_patch_forward_orig) in set_model_unet_function_wrapper; also patches execution.get_output_data
props.architectures: Chroma only: raises unless class name is Chroma.

label: from code
surprise: Replaces execution.get_output_data process-wide when the node runs, to clear its buffers; the name says cache but no difference is measured.
